digest.component_or_area: review-bot persistent tickets clone and autodeploy integration
propositions: The review-bot's persistent tickets clone on EBS-backed external volume diverges during redeploy because the Dockerfile entrypoint only clones when .git is absent, preserving divergent history across redeployments.
The ensure-tickets.sh script lacks fetch, ancestry classification, and reset logic needed to converge divergent persistent clones while the entrypoint invokes it outside the PAT block.
The autodeploy.sh script omits reviewbot-ensure-tickets.sh from BOT_PATHS, preventing deployment of ensure-script changes and breaking self-convergence after redeploy.

Safe clone convergence must preserve local-only commits for compatible stores, reset only pre-epoch clones when the local tip is an ancestor of the prior remote tip, and emit operator-readable warnings for refused adoptions without aborting already-cast votes.
A moving remote-tracking ref between fetch validation and reset requires explicit refspec +refs/heads/tickets:refs/remotes/origin/tickets to prevent convergence to a stale commit.
